name: Cross-body cable extension
cue: Keep the elbow in front and extend down and across.
research: Standing one-arm cable cross-body triceps extension, right arm working, the column on the lifter's left. Design values from the standard technique description (standing sideways to a high pulley, the handle in the arm farther from the stack, the elbow bent with the hand near the opposite shoulder, the forearm straightening on a diagonal down and across the body), not a measured trial. Feet hip width on a plate, knees soft (4), trunk upright, the left hand on the left hip. The right upper arm stays still in front of the chest (shoulder flexion 50, the arm 25 deg across the sagittal plane, scapula protracted 11) while the elbow goes from 105 to 5 deg: the fist travels from beside the chin (0.91 H high, 0.13 H ahead of the pelvis) to a straight arm pointing down and across the body (hand 0.61 H high, 0.26 H ahead and 3 cm left of the midline, in front of the belt). A D-handle rides in the fist (bone-attached, so the hand cannot slip) and its triangle swivels about the grip bar to point along the cable (hinge dswing). The pulley is at 1.10 H (above head height, 2.0 m), 0.45 H out to the left of the stance and 0.05 H ahead of the frontal plane on a column with a stack behind it, so the cable runs across the chest and pulls the hand up and to the left: it leaves the hand 27 deg above horizontal at the start and 50 deg at the end (the moment arm against the cable, the sine of the angle between the forearm and the cable, is 0.70 at the start and 0.94 at the end of the range). Cable 1:1 to the stack. Geometry: design/cableB/cb.mjs.

targets.note: design values (standard technique), not a measured trial: the upper arm stays still, only the elbow moves

camera.note: Research view of the triceps work, the right profile (az 100, el 5), turned 20 deg toward the front (az 80, el 6): the upper arm of the working right arm stays side-on, so the back of the arm reads as a leaf-shaped glow along its underside and the straightening forearm shows the whole sweep down and across the body; the column and cable stand on the far side. fitMachine false: the column may crop at the top.
